meta.title: [fix][broker]Fix thread safety issues in BucketDelayedDeliveryTracker with StampedLock optimistic reads
meta.body_summary: Fix thread safety in BucketDelayedDeliveryTracker by adding StampedLock with optimistic reads for containsMessage() and nextDeliveryTime(), while keeping write operations synchronized; removes unused field and adds benchmark and thread safety tests.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code added StampedLock with optimistic reads; three approvals with LGTM; merged in ~9h; post-merge comment flagged that writeLock was never used but still merged.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 968 changed lines, this is a medium-sized PR by absolute volume, but the core production change is only 94 lines (72 additions, 22 deletions). The majority is test and benchmark code. This small-core, large-incidental pattern fits a targeted performance fix that merges cleanly.

review_details.concern_detail: All three reviewers (Technoboy-, lhotari, coderzc) approved without any inline comments or blocking feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: StampedLock optimistic reads improve throughput for read-heavy operations, with benchmark claims of ~305M ops/s single-threaded and ~2.6B ops/s at 16 threads.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Thread safety fix using StampedLock optimistic reads requires moderate concurrency expertise; agent succeeded with comprehensive test and benchmark support.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewers approved the StampedLock optimistic read pattern; no inline comments or change requests.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes a JMH microbenchmark class and explicit numeric claims in the body, enabling reproduction of performance claims.

core_change_summary.description: Added StampedLock with optimistic read pattern to containsMessage() and nextDeliveryTime() in BucketDelayedDeliveryTracker; write operations remain synchronized; removed unused immutableBucketsMap field; snapshotKey made local variable.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Benchmark and test files constitute 841 of 944 additions; production code change is ~94 lines.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added StampedLock optimistic reads, thread safety test, and JMH benchmark.
Second commit: Made snapshotKey a local variable to avoid field reference.

collaboration_trajectory: Opened PR with fix, thread safety test, and JMH benchmark.
Bot requested doc label; maintainer assigned and added labels.
